base_policy_pinning.decision: the three reconstruction arms (maskco / recon_only / discard_control) share ONE base trajectory: the uncond_dynamic rule arm. strong_rolling is a standalone arm. cond_hist is reported only.
base_policy_pinning.why: the three reconstruction arms must differ ONLY in how the masked orders are re-inserted, so they must share the same starting plan and acceptance bookkeeping. The qualification and both pilots already used uncond_dynamic as the base, so this is continuity rather than a new choice.

contrast_semantics.maskco_vs_recon_only: ATTRIBUTION contrast at identical state, mask schedule, decoder-call count and base: isolates the value of the decoder logits as a guide term.
contrast_semantics.maskco_vs_strong_rolling: DEPLOYMENT contrast: same information, same legal actions and same per-day wall budget, but different base policy (rule base + reconstruction vs a rolling optimizer). This is what the amended main gate asks and it is the question a deployer faces; it is NOT a controlled single-variable ablation and must not be described as one.

base_policy_pinning.subproblem_scope: masked reconstruction is applied per vehicle suffix, restricted to REVEALED and UNSERVED orders, using the same slot-preserving installation as the pilots (propose a permutation of the subproblem order set, install via force_suffix)

freshness_reverified_at_registration.method: ripgrep over the whole workspace root (D:/PyCharm_/MASKCO-Main) for each exact integer literal
freshness_reverified_at_registration.rule: this check MUST be repeated immediately before generation; 'fresh' is a statement about a moment, and the v1 seeds were consumed after v1 was written

data_plan.sample_size_honesty: 8 instances is a RESOURCE-BOUNDED exploratory choice with no power claim; the confirmatory requirement (three fresh 40-complete-day cohorts under its own protocol with alpha_total = 0.05/(j(j+1))) is untouched by this registration

staged_execution.rationale: the program rule 'measure the oracle ceiling AND the learnability ceiling before allocating training budget' plus handover rule 6 ('a learned term that never wins locally cannot win globally') require a cheap stage that can kill the panel before the full 5-arm budget is spent.

stage_a_cheap_gate.question: does the ONLINE ITERATIVE masked reconstruction have any route at all - can it beat its own ONE-SHOT version and the reconstruction-only control on identical states, with local-win counting?
stage_a_cheap_gate.cost: 4 instances, bounded; no strong_rolling or cond_hist arm
reports_required: per-state LOCAL WIN COUNT of the guide term versus the distance-only choice at the SAME state (the delivery lesson: a term that never picks a strictly better option at an identical state is a perturbation by construction)
iterative vs one-shot delta with a paired descriptive interval
every arm's value against the DO-NOTHING base, not only against each other (handover rule 4)
stage_a_cheap_gate.stop_rule: if the guide term records ZERO local wins, or if both reconstruction arms are worse than doing nothing, STOP: do not run stage B. Record as a negative result with the mechanism.

stage_b_panel.actual_decoder_calls: MUST be asserted equal across maskco/recon_only/discard from the run's own counters, never assumed
stage_b_panel.development_gates: as v2 amendment: g1 vs strong_rolling (primary directional), g2 vs recon_only (attribution), g3 vs discard reported, g4 vs cond_hist reported only
stage_b_panel.not_the_main_gate: passing stage B development gates is NOT passing the main gate; a mean above zero is far below the >= 20 utility/day bar

facts.status: GATE FAILS => the 'learn a scoring term over THIS feature family' direction is closed; explicitly NOT a proof that a nonlinear model or richer state cannot learn it

facts.status: the sweep is UNDETERMINED; quoting the favourable fraction would be selection

what_remains_genuinely_untested: the FULL ONLINE ITERATIVE policy with accept-only-on-certified-improvement over a whole day (both pilots were ONE-SHOT interventions at a single decision point)
masked reconstruction at subproblem sizes n>=12 (the pilots ran n=3 and n=4-5 only)
a scoring function that is NONLINEAR or consumes richer state than the 11 features the linear probe used
prior_evidence_about_the_treatment_arm.consequence: stage A exists precisely to test whether the untested iterative route is live before the panel is built; a reader must not treat the registered panel as having a positive expectation.

execution_host.cross_host_expectation: discrete decision structure is expected to be identical between hosts; clock floats differ at ~1e-9..2e-8 (measured). Do NOT claim bit-identical output; claim identical discrete structure.
